name: Advance Nav Menu Manager
author: Ruchir Goswami

sections.description:
Advance Nav Menu Manager simplifies WordPress navigation menu management by providing advanced features for site administrators, including:

  • Move individual menu items to other menus.
  • Copy or duplicate menu items between menus.
  • Disable specific menu items temporarily.
  • User-friendly interface integrated into the WordPress menu editor.
  • JavaScript-driven interaction for easy selection and action.

This plugin is ideal for developers and site managers who want more control over navigation without writing code or manually editing the database.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the advance-nav-menu-manager folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Appearance → Menus and use the new controls under each menu item to move, copy, duplicate, or disable items.
sections.faq:
How do I move a menu item to another menu?

Simply select the target menu from the dropdown under each menu item in the Appearance → Menus section and save.

Can I copy menu items instead of moving them?

Yes, the plugin provides options to duplicate menu items to another menu while retaining the original.

Is there an option to disable a menu item temporarily?

Yes, you can disable a menu item from the menu editor. It remains in the backend and can be re-enabled anytime.
